Class PowerupRoll

java.lang.Object
pong.PowerupRoll
public class PowerupRoll extends Object
Added a slot-machine roll that picks a random powerup for one player The highlight moves through the powerup names, traverse through the powerup names and make each bright then dim, slows to a stop on one, and gives the powerup to the player awarded

    • MAX_ROLL_MS

      public static final int MAX_ROLL_MS
      The longest the spinning animation can take before a powerup starts. The highlight stops on tick MIN_TICKS + (0 to REWARD_COUNT - 1), and the first tick happens after one interval, so the latest stop is (MIN_TICKS + REWARD_COUNT) intervals.

    • start

      public void start(JLabel[] labels, Paddle player, Paddle opponent, int durationMs)
      Spins the highlight through the powerup names, then turns on whichever one it lands on.
      Parameters:
      labels - the player's powerup labels
      player - the paddle that rolled
      opponent - the other paddle
      durationMs - how long the chosen powerup lasts, in milliseconds
